summary: Coverage run for backend/src/core/database.ts. createDatabase was already exercised by the repository tests, but initialize had no test. I added two cases to backend/tests/repository.test.ts: one checks that a single idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS todos statement runs, and one checks that schema-initialization errors are passed on to the caller. All 50 backend tests pass, typecheck is clean, and database.ts is at 100% line and branch coverage.

files.rationale: The existing repository tests already used createDatabase but never called initialize, so I added cases for its successful run and for an error being passed through.

findings.message: Total backend coverage is about 34% lines because other modules, such as lifespan.ts, are only partly covered. Those modules were outside this plan. Coverage thresholds still pass.
